comments.author: Farshid Shirafkan, PhD
comments.comment: The highest ROI topic here is evaluation: define failure modes before optimizing prompts, RAG, or agent loops. A knowledge assistant that can say “not enough evidence” with citations is often more production-ready than one that answers every question confidently.

comments.author: Nick Gushchin
comments.comment:
The autonomy/control tradeoff gets much sharper once you add failure recovery.

A real persistent agent needs more than memory + triggers, it needs inspectable state, resumable workflows, and a clean handoff path when confidence drops. Without that, “always on” turns into “always debugging.”
